sources.title: Kao Data July 21 resident letter confirms Park Royal proposal
sources.summary: Signed Programme Director letter names the former Frogmore site on Acton Lane. July 27 demolition is future planned work; the proposed data centre remains a separate planning application. July 21 supports announced status only.
sources.date_semantics: July 21 is exact signed proposal confirmation; July 27 is forecast demolition.

sources.title: Kao Data September 2026 public consultation boards

The revised data-centre design requires separate planning approval. Boards identify Kao as intended owner and operator. September is a publication month, not an exact achieved construction date.
sources.date_semantics: Source record or retrieval timing does not establish achieved physical work.
